import json, re, math

d = "M 95.00,40.00 A 27.00,27.00 0.00 1,0 41.00,40.00 A 27.00,27.00 0.00 1,0 95.00,40.00"

tokens = re.findall(r"[A-Za-z]|-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?", d)
i = 0
cmds = []
while i < len(tokens):
    t = tokens[i]
    if t == "M":
        cmds.append(("M", float(tokens[i+1]), float(tokens[i+2])))
        i += 3
    elif t == "A":
        v = list(map(float, tokens[i+1:i+8]))
        cmds.append(("A", *v))
        i += 8
    else:
        i += 1

start = (cmds[0][1], cmds[0][2])
arcs = [c for c in cmds if c[0] == "A"]

cur = start
all_circle = True
evidence = []
for a in arcs:
    rx, ry, rot, large, sweep, x, y = a[1:]
    chord = math.hypot(x - cur[0], y - cur[1])
    # chord equals diameter -> each arc is a half circle when rx == ry
    half = abs(chord - 2 * rx) < 1e-9 and rx == ry
    evidence.append({"rx": rx, "ry": ry, "chord": chord, "diameter": 2 * rx, "half_circle": half})
    all_circle = all_circle and half
    cur = (x, y)

closed = abs(cur[0] - start[0]) < 1e-9 and abs(cur[1] - start[1]) < 1e-9

if len(arcs) == 2 and all_circle and closed:
    ans = "(A) circle"
elif len(arcs) == 2 and closed and arcs[0][1] != arcs[0][2]:
    ans = "(K) ellipse"
else:
    ans = "UNSUPPORTED"

print(json.dumps({"final_answer": ans, "evidence": {"arcs": evidence, "closed": closed}}))
